purpose: Accumulate current evidence prospectively so future RK-MIS validation does not depend on sparse retrospective reconstruction.

smart_money.reason: Current RK-MIS operating mode is GitHub-only without Upstox/NAS dependency. The point-in-time journal and 4Q release guards remain available for a future authorized structured source, but no provider history is backfilled and no inactive provider is represented as live evidence.
smart_money.feature_release_rule: A 4Q change requires five actually observed point-in-time periods spanning 330-400 days. Missing component values are not imputed.

documentary_discovery.rule: Only chronology-safe, SHA-pinned, reviewed A/B primary evidence may fill approved feature fields. Automated candidates remain PENDING and are not scores.

catalyst_execution.orderbook_to_sales_rule: Requires an explicitly aggregate order book plus an explicit TTM-revenue field from the matched base company input.
catalyst_execution.individual_purchase_order_rule: May support order quality but must not be relabelled as aggregate order book.
catalyst_execution.capex_execution_rule: Uses the frozen status score less delay penalty. Planned capacity increase remains missing without comparable current/planned capacity units.

global_rules: ISIN-first identity where available; symbol-only evidence may merge only when identity is unambiguous.
No provider category relabelling merely to improve coverage.
No score-band or pillar-weight change from prospective tracking itself.
Future return testing must be preregistered before outcome load.
Management promise delivery remains unavailable until at least three closed reviewed promises.
Automated document keyword hits never become scores without review.
Full-market systematic corporate-document scraping is not enabled; live discovery remains bounded to the explicit RK-MIS shortlist.
